limitations: NoopIsm on Sepolia is permissive. Anyone with a valid Hyperlane message can call Sepolia Mailbox.process and have it land on our TestRecipient. Mainnet must use MultisigIsm with vetted validators.
We acted as the relayer manually (called Sepolia Mailbox.process from our wallet). Production requires automated validator + relayer agents running 24/7.
Demo is one-way: Sentrix Testnet -> Sepolia. Reverse direction requires reciprocal config (Sentrix-side ISM accepting Sepolia messages + cross-chain delivery from Sepolia).

production_path: Replace NoopIsm with StaticMessageIdMultisigIsm configured with a real validator set
